title: Fine-Tuning BERT for Sentiment Analysis: What Building This Project Actually Taught Me
description: A deep dive into building a Transformer-based sentiment analysis system using Hugging Face, PyTorch, and BERT and the lessons learned while training real NLP models.
content: Most NLP tutorials stop at running a model. I wanted to understand what actually happens when you train, fine-tune, evaluate, and deploy a Transformer model in a real workflow. This project started as an exploration into sentiment analysis using BERT, but quickly turned into a deeper learning experience around deep learning pipelines, tokenization, evaluation metrics, overfitting, and deployment. Using Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch, I built a complete sentiment classification system trained on IMDb reviews and deployed the fine-tuned model for inference.

title: Building the AI SQL Assistant: From Natural Language to SQL Instantly
description: A journey into creating an intelligent SQL assistant using LLMs, LangChain, and real-time query execution.
content: Have you ever wanted to interact with a database without writing a single line of SQL? That’s exactly what inspired the AI SQL Assistant. The idea was simple yet ambitious: allow users to type plain English queries, convert them into SQL, execute them, and return results instantly. Leveraging the power of Hugging Face LLMs and LangChain, this project transforms natural language into executable queries and even handles errors autonomously. It’s a tool for data analysts, developers, and AI enthusiasts who want to explore databases effortlessly.

title: Vocilite: Simple Text Explanations with Voice
description: I built a Chrome extension that explains complex text in plain English and reads it aloud - exploring LLMs, voice, and real-world usability.
